mapper.sql:
p.PROJ_ID AS "projectId", p.PROJ_NM AS "projectName", p.CUST_CLNT_ID AS "customerId", CASE WHEN p.CTRT_TYPE_CD='IN' THEN '(자체)' ELSE c.CLNT_NM END AS "customerName", p.CTRT_TYPE_CD AS "contractTypeCode", t.CODE_NM AS "contractTypeName", p.CTRT_BGN_DT AS "startDate", p.CTRT_END_DT AS "endDate", p.WORK_PLC_ADDR AS "workplace", CASE WHEN p.PROJ_STAT_CD!='LOSE' AND p.CTRT_END_DT < #{today} THEN 'END' ELSE p.PROJ_STAT_CD END AS "statusCode", (SELECT s.CODE_NM FROM TB_SY_CODE s WHERE s.CODE_GRP_ID='PROJ_STAT' AND s.CODE= CASE WHEN p.PROJ_STAT_CD!='LOSE' AND p.CTRT_END_DT < #{today} THEN 'END' ELSE p.PROJ_STAT_CD END) AS "statusName", p.EST_AMT AS "estimateAmount", p.ORGNL_CTRT_AMT AS "originalContractAmount", p.CTRT_AMT AS "contractAmount", p.BDGT_AMT AS "budgetAmount", p.BDGT_MANUAL_YN AS "budgetManualYn", p.TEAM_EXPS_AMT AS "teamExpenseAmount", p.PROJ_EXPS_AMT AS "projectExpenseAmount", p.FEATURE_CN AS "feature", pp.PART_ID AS "salesPartId", pp.PART_NM AS "salesPartName", COALESCE(p.MOD_DTTM, p.REG_DTTM) AS "modifiedAt", p.LOSE_DT AS "loseDate", lr.CODE_NM AS "loseReasonName", p.LOSE_MEMO AS "loseMemo", (SELECT string_agg(u.USER_NM, ', ' ORDER BY u.USER_ID) FROM TB_SY_USER u WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_SY_USER_SCOPE sc WHERE sc.USER_ID=u.USER_ID AND sc.SCOPE_TYPE_CD='PROJ' AND sc.PROJ_ID=p.PROJ_ID) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_SY_USER_ROLE ur WHERE ur.USER_ID=u.USER_ID AND ur.ROLE_ID='PM')) AS "pmName",
(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.DEV_ID) FROM TB_PJ_ASGN a WHERE a.PROJ_ID=p.PROJ_ID AND a.ASGN_STAT_CD!='CNCL') AS "assignedPeopleCount", (SELECT cd.CODE_NM FROM TB_PJ_TK_DSTRB d JOIN TB_SY_CODE cd ON cd.CODE_GRP_ID='DSTRB_STEP' AND cd.CODE=d.DSTRB_STEP_CD WHERE d.PROJ_ID=p.PROJ_ID ORDER BY cd.SORT_ORD DESC LIMIT 1) AS "distributionStepName"

FROM TB_PJ_PROJ p LEFT JOIN TB_BS_CLNT c ON c.CLNT_ID=p.CUST_CLNT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE t ON t.CODE_GRP_ID='CTRT_TYPE' AND t.CODE=p.CTRT_TYPE_CD LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE lr ON lr.CODE_GRP_ID='LOSE_RSN' AND lr.CODE=p.LOSE_RSN_CD LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT h.PART_ID, b.PART_NM FROM TB_PJ_PROJ_PART h LEFT JOIN TB_BS_PART b ON b.PART_ID=h.PART_ID WHERE h.PROJ_ID=p.PROJ_ID AND h.APLY_BGN_YM <= #{month} ORDER BY h.APLY_BGN_YM DESC LIMIT 1) pp ON TRUE
mapper.select: SELECT ORDER BY p.CTRT_BGN_DT DESC, p.PROJ_ID ASC
SELECT WHERE p.PROJ_ID=#{id}
SELECT PROJ_ID FROM TB_PJ_PROJ WHERE PROJ_ID=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: LOCK TABLE TB_PJ_PROJ, TB_PJ_PROJ_PART, TB_PJ_PROJ_CHG, TB_PJ_ASGN, TB_PJ_ASGN_HIST, TB_PJ_TK_DSTRB, TB_PJ_DRCT_EXPS, TB_PJ_MNPW_PLAN, TB_CL_CLOSE, TB_BL_BILL IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE
mapper.select: SELECT PROJ_ID FROM TB_PJ_PROJ ORDER BY PROJ_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PJ_PROJ (PROJ_ID, PROJ_NM, CUST_CLNT_ID, CTRT_TYPE_CD, PROJ_STAT_CD, CTRT_BGN_DT, CTRT_END_DT, WORK_PLC_ADDR, EST_AMT, ORGNL_CTRT_AMT, CTRT_AMT, BDGT_AMT, BDGT_MANUAL_YN, TEAM_EXPS_AMT, PROJ_EXPS_AMT, FEATURE_CN, REG_USER_ID, REG_DTTM) VALUES (#{project.projectId}, #{project.projectName}, #{project.customerId}, #{project.contractTypeCode}, #{project.statusCode}, #{project.startDate}, #{project.endDate}, #{project.workplace}, #{project.estimateAmount}, #{project.originalContractAmount}, #{project.contractAmount}, #{project.budgetAmount}, #{project.budgetManualYn}, #{project.teamExpenseAmount}, #{project.projectExpenseAmount}, #{project.feature}, #{actor}, clock_timestamp())
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_PJ_PROJ SET PROJ_NM=#{project.projectName}, CUST_CLNT_ID=#{project.customerId}, CTRT_BGN_DT=#{project.startDate}, CTRT_END_DT=#{project.endDate}, WORK_PLC_ADDR=#{project.workplace}, EST_AMT=#{project.estimateAmount}, ORGNL_CTRT_AMT=#{project.originalContractAmount}, CTRT_AMT=#{project.contractAmount}, BDGT_AMT=#{project.budgetAmount}, BDGT_MANUAL_YN=#{project.budgetManualYn}, TEAM_EXPS_AMT=#{project.teamExpenseAmount}, PROJ_EXPS_AMT=#{project.projectExpenseAmount}, FEATURE_CN=#{project.feature}, PROJ_STAT_CD=#{project.statusCode}, MOD_USER_ID=#{actor}, MOD_DTTM=clock_timestamp() WHERE PROJ_ID=#{project.projectId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PJ_PROJ_CHG (PROJ_ID, HIST_SN, CHG_ITEM_CD, CHG_ITEM_NM, BFR_VAL, AFT_VAL, CHG_DT, REG_USER_ID, REG_DTTM) SELECT #{projectId}, COALESCE(MAX(HIST_SN),0)+1, #{code}, #{name}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, (clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date, #{actor}, clock_timestamp() FROM TB_PJ_PROJ_CHG WHERE PROJ_ID=#{projectId}
mapper.select: SELECT h.REG_DTTM AS "changedAt", h.CHG_ITEM_NM AS "itemName", h.BFR_VAL AS "beforeValue", h.AFT_VAL AS "afterValue", COALESCE(u.USER_NM,h.REG_USER_ID) AS "changedBy" FROM TB_PJ_PROJ_CHG h LEFT JOIN TB_SY_USER u ON u.USER_ID=h.REG_USER_ID WHERE h.PROJ_ID=#{id} ORDER BY h.REG_DTTM DESC, h.HIST_SN DESC

SELECT h.PART_ID AS "salesPartId", b.PART_NM AS "salesPartName", substring(h.APLY_BGN_YM,1,4)||'-'||substring(h.APLY_BGN_YM,5,2) AS "effectiveMonth", h.CHG_RSN AS "reason", COALESCE(u.USER_NM,h.REG_USER_ID) AS "changedBy", h.APLY_BGN_YM > #{month} AS "scheduled" FROM TB_PJ_PROJ_PART h LEFT JOIN TB_BS_PART b ON b.PART_ID=h.PART_ID LEFT JOIN TB_SY_USER u ON u.USER_ID=h.REG_USER_ID WHERE h.PROJ_ID=#{id} ORDER BY h.APLY_BGN_YM ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_PJ_PROJ_PART h WHERE h.PROJ_ID=#{id} AND h.APLY_BGN_YM > #{closed} AND h.APLY_BGN_YM != (SELECT MIN(x.APLY_BGN_YM) FROM TB_PJ_PROJ_PART x WHERE x.PROJ_ID=#{id})
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(CLOSE_YM) FROM TB_CL_CLOSE WHERE CLOSE_STAT_CD='CLOSE'
SELECT CODE_VAL FROM TB_SY_CODE WHERE CODE_GRP_ID='ALWNC' AND CODE=#{code} AND USE_YN='Y' AND DEL_YN='N'
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_BS_CLNT WHERE CLNT_ID=#{id} AND USE_YN='Y' AND CLNT_TYPE_CD IN ('CUST','BOTH'))
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_BS_PART WHERE PART_ID=#{id} AND USE_YN='Y')
SELECT CLNT_NM FROM TB_BS_CLNT WHERE CLNT_ID=#{id}
SELECT CODE_NM FROM TB_SY_CODE WHERE CODE_GRP_ID=#{group} AND CODE=#{code} AND USE_YN='Y' AND DEL_YN='N'
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_BL_BILL WHERE PROJ_ID=#{id} AND CNCL_YN='N')

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PJ_ASGN a WHERE a.PROJ_ID=#{id} AND a.ASGN_STAT_CD!='CNCL' AND (a.INPUT_BGN_DT < #{start} OR a.INPUT_END_DT > #{end})) AS "assignments", (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.DSTRB_YM) FROM TB_PJ_TK_DSTRB d WHERE d.PROJ_ID=#{id} AND d.DSTRB_AMT!=0 AND (d.DSTRB_YM < to_char(#{start}::date,'YYYYMM') OR d.DSTRB_YM > to_char(#{end}::date,'YYYYMM'))) AS "distributionMonths", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PJ_DRCT_EXPS e WHERE e.PROJ_ID=#{id} AND (e.EXPS_YM < to_char(#{start}::date,'YYYYMM') OR e.EXPS_YM > to_char(#{end}::date,'YYYYMM'))) AS "expenses", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PJ_ASGN a WHERE a.PROJ_ID=#{id} AND a.ASGN_STAT_CD!='CNCL' AND a.INPUT_BGN_DT <= #{today} AND a.INPUT_BGN_DT < #{start}) AS "started"

SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_PJ_PROJ p JOIN TB_CL_CLOSE c ON c.CLOSE_YM BETWEEN to_char(p.CTRT_BGN_DT,'YYYYMM') AND to_char(p.CTRT_END_DT,'YYYYMM') WHERE p.PROJ_ID=#{id} AND c.CLOSE_STAT_CD='CLOSE' AND (c.CLOSE_YM < to_char(#{start}::date,'YYYYMM') OR c.CLOSE_YM > to_char(#{end}::date,'YYYYMM')))

SELECT d.DEV_NM AS "name", d.MNG_NO AS "managementNumber", c.CODE_NM AS "jobName", a.INPUT_BGN_DT AS "startDate", a.INPUT_END_DT AS "endDate", a.CTRT_MM AS "mm" FROM TB_PJ_ASGN a JOIN TB_HR_DEV d ON d.DEV_ID=a.DEV_ID LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE c ON c.CODE_GRP_ID='JOB' AND c.CODE=a.JOB_CD WHERE a.PROJ_ID=#{id} AND a.ASGN_STAT_CD!='CNCL' ORDER BY a.INPUT_BGN_DT,a.ASGN_ID

SELECT ASGN_ID AS "assignmentId", DEV_ID AS "developerId", INPUT_BGN_DT AS "startDate", INPUT_END_DT AS "endDate" FROM TB_PJ_ASGN WHERE PROJ_ID=#{id} AND ASGN_STAT_CD!='CNCL' ORDER BY ASGN_ID FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PJ_ASGN_HIST (ASGN_ID,HIST_SN,ASGN_CHG_TYPE_CD,APLY_DT,BFR_VAL,AFT_VAL,ASGN_CHG_RSN_CD,CHG_MEMO,REG_USER_ID,REG_DTTM) SELECT a.ASGN_ID,(SELECT COALESCE(MAX(h.HIST_SN),0)+1 FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_HIST h WHERE h.ASGN_ID=a.ASGN_ID), #{kind},#{today},CASE WHEN #{kind}='EARLY' THEN '종료 '||a.INPUT_END_DT::text ELSE a.INPUT_BGN_DT::text||' ~ '||a.INPUT_END_DT::text END, CASE WHEN #{kind}='EARLY' THEN '철수 '||#{today}::text ELSE '배정 취소' END,'ETC',#{memo},#{actor},clock_timestamp() FROM TB_PJ_ASGN a WHERE a.ASGN_ID=#{assignmentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_PJ_ASGN SET INPUT_END_DT=#{today}, EARLY_WTHDR_YN='Y', ASGN_STAT_CD='CNCL', MOD_USER_ID=#{actor},MOD_DTTM=clock_timestamp() WHERE ASGN_ID=#{assignmentId}
mapper.select: SELECT ASGN_ID AS "assignmentId", DEV_ID AS "developerId", INPUT_BGN_DT AS "startDate", INPUT_END_DT AS "endDate" FROM TB_PJ_ASGN WHERE PROJ_ID=#{id} AND ASGN_STAT_CD!='CNCL' ORDER BY ASGN_ID
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_PJ_PROJ SET PROJ_STAT_CD='ING', MOD_USER_ID=#{actor}, MOD_DTTM=clock_timestamp() WHERE PROJ_ID=#{id} AND PROJ_STAT_CD='PRE'
mapper.select: SELECT ur.ROLE_ID FROM TB_SY_USER_ROLE ur JOIN TB_SY_ROLE r ON r.ROLE_ID=ur.ROLE_ID WHERE ur.USER_ID=#{userId} AND r.USE_YN='Y'
SELECT PROJ_ID FROM TB_SY_USER_SCOPE WHERE USER_ID=#{userId} AND SCOPE_TYPE_CD='PROJ'

WITH actual AS (SELECT a.JOB_CD,SUM(m.MON_MM) mm FROM TB_PJ_ASGN a JOIN TB_PJ_ASGN_MON m ON m.ASGN_ID=a.ASGN_ID WHERE a.PROJ_ID=#{id} AND a.ASGN_STAT_CD!='CNCL' GROUP BY a.JOB_CD), jobs AS (SELECT JOB_CD FROM actual UNION SELECT JOB_CD FROM TB_PJ_MNPW_PLAN WHERE PROJ_ID=#{id}) SELECT j.JOB_CD AS "jobCode",c.CODE_NM AS "jobName",p.PLAN_MM AS "plannedMm", COALESCE(a.mm,0) AS "actualMm", CASE WHEN p.PLAN_MM IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(a.mm,0)-p.PLAN_MM END AS "differenceMm" FROM jobs j LEFT JOIN actual a ON a.JOB_CD=j.JOB_CD LEFT JOIN TB_PJ_MNPW_PLAN p ON p.PROJ_ID=#{id} AND p.JOB_CD=j.JOB_CD LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE c ON c.CODE_GRP_ID='JOB' AND c.CODE=j.JOB_CD ORDER BY c.SORT_ORD,j.JOB_CD
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PJ_MNPW_PLAN (PROJ_ID,JOB_CD,PLAN_MM,SRC_CD,REG_USER_ID,REG_DTTM) VALUES (#{projectId},#{job.jobCode},#{job.plannedMm},'MANUAL',#{actor},clock_timestamp()) ON CONFLICT (PROJ_ID,JOB_CD) DO UPDATE SET PLAN_MM=EXCLUDED.PLAN_MM,SRC_CD='MANUAL', MOD_USER_ID=EXCLUDED.REG_USER_ID,MOD_DTTM=clock_timestamp()
mapper.select: SELECT e.EXPS_YM||':'||e.EXPS_SN::text AS "expenseId", substring(e.EXPS_YM,1,4)||'-'||substring(e.EXPS_YM,5,2) AS "yearMonth", e.DRCT_EXPS_ITEM_CD AS "itemCode",c.CODE_NM AS "itemName",e.EXPS_AMT AS "amount",e.RMRK AS "memo" FROM TB_PJ_DRCT_EXPS e LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE c ON c.CODE_GRP_ID='DRCT_EXPS_ITEM' AND c.CODE=e.DRCT_EXPS_ITEM_CD WHERE e.PROJ_ID=#{id} ORDER BY e.REG_DTTM DESC,e.EXPS_YM DESC,e.EXPS_SN DESC
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(EXPS_SN),0)+1 FROM TB_PJ_DRCT_EXPS WHERE PROJ_ID=#{id} AND EXPS_YM=#{month}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_PJ_DRCT_EXPS WHERE PROJ_ID=#{projectId} AND EXPS_YM=#{month} AND EXPS_SN=#{sequence}
mapper.select: SELECT c.CODE_NM AS "stepName",s.STEP_WGHT_RT AS "weightRate",s.PLAN_BGN_DT AS "plannedStartDate", s.PLAN_END_DT AS "plannedEndDate",s.CMPL_DT AS "completedDate" FROM TB_PJ_STEP s LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE c ON c.CODE_GRP_ID='PROJ_STEP' AND c.CODE=s.PROJ_STEP_CD WHERE s.PROJ_ID=#{id} ORDER BY s.STEP_SN

SELECT i.ISSUE_TTL AS "issueTitle",i.IMPR_CD AS "importanceCode",c.CODE_NM AS "importanceName",i.DDLN_DT AS "dueDate", i.ISSUE_STAT_CD AS "statusCode",s.CODE_NM AS "statusName",i.ACTN_CN AS "action" FROM TB_PJ_ISSUE i LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE c ON c.CODE_GRP_ID='IMPR' AND c.CODE=i.IMPR_CD LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE s ON s.CODE_GRP_ID='ISSUE_STAT' AND s.CODE=i.ISSUE_STAT_CD WHERE i.PROJ_ID=#{id} ORDER BY CASE WHEN i.ISSUE_STAT_CD='CLOSE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, c.SORT_ORD NULLS LAST, i.DDLN_DT NULLS LAST, i.ISSUE_ID

SELECT WRT_DT AS "writtenDate",THIS_WEEK_CN AS "thisWeek",NEXT_WEEK_CN AS "nextWeek",REQ_CN AS "request", ACTL_PRGRS_RT AS "actualProgressRate" FROM TB_PJ_WEEK_MEMO WHERE PROJ_ID=#{id} ORDER BY WRT_DT DESC, MEMO_SN DESC
SELECT ACTL_PRGRS_RT FROM TB_PJ_WEEK_MEMO WHERE PROJ_ID=#{id} AND ACTL_PRGRS_RT IS NOT NULL ORDER BY WRT_DT DESC,MEMO_SN DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (SELECT MAX(WRT_DT) FROM TB_PJ_WEEK_MEMO WHERE PROJ_ID=#{id}) AS "latestMemoDate", EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_PJ_ISSUE WHERE PROJ_ID=#{id} AND ISSUE_STAT_CD!='CLOSE' AND DDLN_DT < #{today}) AS "overdueIssue", EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_PJ_ISSUE WHERE PROJ_ID=#{id} AND ISSUE_STAT_CD!='CLOSE' AND IMPR_CD='HIGH' AND DDLN_DT < #{today}) AS "overdueHighIssue", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PJ_ISSUE WHERE PROJ_ID=#{id} AND ISSUE_STAT_CD!='CLOSE' AND DDLN_DT < #{today}) AS "overdueCount", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PJ_ISSUE WHERE PROJ_ID=#{id} AND ISSUE_STAT_CD!='CLOSE' AND IMPR_CD='HIGH' AND DDLN_DT < #{today}) AS "overdueHighCount", (SELECT CAST(MIN(s.REG_DTTM AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') AS date) FROM TB_PJ_STEP s WHERE s.PROJ_ID=#{id}) AS "stagesCreatedDate", COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.EXPS_AMT) FROM TB_PJ_DRCT_EXPS e WHERE e.PROJ_ID=#{id} AND e.EXPS_YM <= to_char(CAST(#{today} AS date),'YYYYMM')),0) AS "additionalExpenseAmount"

SELECT COST_YM AS "yearMonth", COST_CLS_CD AS "costClassCode", SUM(LABOR_ALLOC_AMT + DRCT_EXPS_AMT) AS "totalAmount" FROM TB_CO_MON_COST WHERE PROJ_ID=#{id} AND COST_YM <= #{month} GROUP BY COST_YM, COST_CLS_CD ORDER BY COST_YM, COST_CLS_CD

SELECT d.ROW_SN AS "rowNumber",d.ROW_TYPE_CD AS "rowTypeCode",d.DEV_ID AS "developerId", h.MNG_NO AS "managementNumber",h.DEV_NM AS "name",d.ITEM_NM AS "itemName", substring(d.DSTRB_YM,1,4)||'-'||substring(d.DSTRB_YM,5,2) AS "yearMonth",d.DSTRB_AMT AS "amount" FROM TB_PJ_TK_DSTRB d LEFT JOIN TB_HR_DEV h ON h.DEV_ID=d.DEV_ID WHERE d.PROJ_ID=#{id} AND d.DSTRB_STEP_CD=() ORDER BY d.ROW_SN,d.DSTRB_YM

SELECT u.REG_DTTM AS "uploadedAt",u.TRGT_DSTRB_STEP_CD AS "stepCode",c.CODE_NM AS "stepName", u.FILE_NM AS "fileName",COALESCE(a.USER_NM,u.REG_USER_ID) AS "uploadedBy" FROM TB_SY_UPLD u LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE c ON c.CODE_GRP_ID='DSTRB_STEP' AND c.CODE=u.TRGT_DSTRB_STEP_CD LEFT JOIN TB_SY_USER a ON a.USER_ID=u.REG_USER_ID WHERE u.TRGT_PROJ_ID=#{id} AND u.FORM_TYPE_CD='B6' ORDER BY u.REG_DTTM DESC,u.UPLD_ID DESC

WITH jobs AS (SELECT a.JOB_CD,MIN(a.INPUT_BGN_DT) first_date FROM TB_PJ_ASGN a WHERE a.PROJ_ID=#{id} AND a.DEV_ID=#{developerId} AND a.ASGN_STAT_CD!='CNCL' GROUP BY a.JOB_CD), chosen AS (SELECT j.JOB_CD,j.first_date FROM jobs j UNION ALL SELECT d.JOB_CD,NULL::date FROM TB_HR_DEV d WHERE d.DEV_ID=#{developerId} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jobs)) SELECT j.JOB_CD AS "code",c.CODE_NM AS "name" FROM chosen j LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE c ON c.CODE_GRP_ID='JOB' AND c.CODE=j.JOB_CD ORDER BY j.first_date,j.JOB_CD

WITH distributed AS (SELECT DISTINCT d.DEV_ID,d.DSTRB_YM ym FROM TB_PJ_TK_DSTRB d WHERE d.PROJ_ID=#{id} AND d.ROW_TYPE_CD='DEV' AND d.DSTRB_AMT!=0 AND d.DSTRB_STEP_CD=()), assigned AS (SELECT DISTINCT a.DEV_ID,to_char(m,'YYYYMM') ym FROM TB_PJ_ASGN a CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(date_trunc('month',a.INPUT_BGN_DT),date_trunc('month',a.INPUT_END_DT),interval '1 month') m WHERE a.PROJ_ID=#{id} AND a.ASGN_STAT_CD!='CNCL'), missing AS (SELECT COALESCE(d.DEV_ID,a.DEV_ID) dev,COALESCE(d.ym,a.ym) ym, CASE WHEN a.DEV_ID IS NULL THEN '배정 없음' ELSE '배분표 없음' END kind FROM distributed d FULL JOIN assigned a ON a.DEV_ID=d.DEV_ID AND a.ym=d.ym WHERE a.DEV_ID IS NULL OR d.DEV_ID IS NULL) SELECT h.DEV_NM AS "name",m.kind AS "kind",substring(m.ym,1,4)||'-'||substring(m.ym,5,2) AS "yearMonth" FROM missing m JOIN TB_HR_DEV h ON h.DEV_ID=m.dev ORDER BY h.DEV_ID,m.kind,m.ym
SELECT CLNT_ID AS id,CLNT_NM AS name,BIZ_REG_NO AS "businessNumber" FROM TB_BS_CLNT WHERE USE_YN='Y' AND CLNT_TYPE_CD IN ('CUST','BOTH') ORDER BY CLNT_ID
SELECT PART_ID AS code,PART_NM AS name FROM TB_BS_PART WHERE USE_YN='Y' ORDER BY PART_ID
SELECT DEV_ID AS id,DEV_NM AS name FROM TB_HR_DEV WHERE MNG_NO=#{managementNumber}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_PJ_TK_DSTRB WHERE PROJ_ID=#{id} AND DSTRB_STEP_CD=#{stage}
